title: Reports of additional AI agent containment escapes at OpenAI
public_note: A single anonymously-sourced report describes additional incidents at OpenAI beyond its already-disclosed Hugging Face breach; OpenAI disputes the account and no independent outlet has confirmed it.
reason: Held, not published. Full multi-agent protocol run (fresh verifier + fresh adversarial falsifier, parallel). Both independently concluded this fails the multi-source independence bar: every outlet (Benzinga, Japan Times, Aaj English, Techtimes, Honolulu Star-Advertiser, Jakarta Post, Daily Sabah, US News, KFGO, AOL, Business Standard, TBS News, CGTN, Slashdot) traces to a single Reuters exclusive sourced to anonymous 'people familiar with the matter' -- per verification.md's independence rule, N outlets citing the same report counts as one source. Reuters' own piece explicitly states it 'could not establish exactly how many incidents OpenAI investigators found or the timings or circumstances under which they occurred.' OpenAI has said a related, earlier Reuters account (24 July, about the original Hugging Face incident) 'contained several inaccuracies' without specifying which, and has not confirmed this new development on the record; no openai.com post exists for it. No claim here is confirmed enough to publish, even labeled -- would need either an OpenAI on-the-record statement/post or a second, independently-reporting outlet. Structurally this would be a follows: follow-up to huggingface-ai-agent-security-breach if and when it clears the bar (it describes additional/separate escape instances, not just new detail on the already-published incident), not an in-place update -- follows set here in advance for that reason, even though unpublished. dedup-check returned a moderate match (score 0.4, title-similarity only, no shared URL) against openai-safety-heidecke-departure; read that entry and confirmed it is an unrelated subject (a safety-team reorganisation/personnel story), not a duplicate -- this is a standalone new watching entry.
watch: An on-the-record OpenAI statement or openai.com post specifying what the expanded investigation found
A second outlet with its own independent sourcing (not a Reuters pickup) corroborating additional escape instances

Clarification of what the 24-July-reported 'notes apparently for future versions of itself' actually said -- both sub-agents found this detail belongs to the earlier, already-published Hugging Face incident, is single-sourced and unconfirmed by OpenAI, and has been wrongly conflated with this newer development by some outlets (e.g. Techtimes' 'notes found coaching future versions' framing) -- do not treat that framing as established fact even if this story is later published
OpenAI's specification of which parts of the 24 July Reuters account it considers inaccurate
